razao: Agricola is a complex resource-management domain from IPC 2018 with long sequential dependencies and large state spaces. A portfolio planner using forward state-space search with delete-relaxation, causal-graph, and landmark heuristics (like Fast Downward Stone Soup or LAMA) is robust and generally achieves very high coverage on such classical domains.
